$comment: The five festival events, in journey order by date (SFC -> Film Exhibition -> Under the Stars -> Educational Screening -> Main Screening). `id` is used in films/schedule; `theme` is the colour theme (sfc | exh | uts | main | base). `title` lines build the big display title; `script` (optional) is a word that is genuinely part of the name, drawn in script between the lines (e.g. Under *the* Stars). Media keys refer to media.json. `strip` is the list of media keys shown on that event's frames in the home film strip (video or image, any number); add keys to media.json first. `badge` (optional) is a small label next to the name, e.g. "New". `shortDate` is the short date in the navbar Events menu. `heroScene` picks the scroll-driven 3D hero: clapper | gallery | open-air | book | theatre (leave it out for a plain hero). `keyDates` (optional): the dates shown on the event page timeline, YYYY-MM-DD + a short label; only confirmed dates. `heroSlate` (optional): the small label in the corner of the 3D hero.

items.name: Short Film Competition
title: Short Film
Competition
items.summary: An annual student filmmaking contest, open globally: short films made on a set topic, with the winners revealed at the Film Exhibition.
description: The Short Film Competition is an annual student filmmaking contest, open to filmmakers around the world. Entrants submit short films made on a specific topic, and it showcases emerging voices and original stories.
Submissions open on 2 November 2026 and close on 8 February 2027. The winners are announced on 27 February 2027, and the Grand Winner is showcased at the Film Exhibition.
The topic and submission rules will be announced soon.
items.dateLabel: Submissions 2 Nov 2026 to 8 Feb 2027 · Winners 27 Feb 2027

items.name: Film Exhibition
title: Film
Exhibition
items.tagline: Indonesian cinema, off the screen and into the room.
items.summary: New this year: a curated exhibition bringing Indonesian cinema to life through iconic films, props, costumes, memorabilia and behind-the-scenes stories, plus the SFC Grand Winner.
description: New for the 21st edition, the Film Exhibition is a curated exhibition that brings Indonesian cinema to life by showcasing iconic films, props, costumes, memorabilia and behind-the-scenes stories.
It also showcases the Short Film Competition Grand Winner alongside archival film materials.
Venue, opening hours and tickets will be announced soon.

title: Under
Stars
items.tagline: Indonesian cinema, open-air, under the Melbourne sky.
items.summary: An outdoor cinema night and cultural festival: an open-air screening alongside live performances, food stalls and cultural activities.
description: Under the Stars is an outdoor cinema night and cultural festival: an open-air screening of an Indonesian film alongside live performances, food stalls and cultural activities.
Venue and film for the 21st edition will be announced soon.

items.name: Educational Screening
title: Educational
Screening
items.tagline: Indonesian culture through film, for schools.
items.summary: A school program at ACMI teaching Indonesian culture through film, cultural performances and interactive workshops.
description: The Educational Screening is a school-focused program at ACMI that teaches Indonesian culture through film. Students watch an Indonesian film and take part in cultural performances and interactive workshops.
Schools interested in attending can email us. Film and session details will be announced soon.

items.tagline: Three days. The grand premiere of the festival.
items.summary: The grand premiere: three days of watching Indonesian films together, with a special talk show and artist showcase.
description: The Main Screening is the grand premiere of the festival: three days of "nobar" (watching together) curated Indonesian films, featuring a special talk show and artist showcase.
The lineup and guests for the 21st edition will be announced soon.
